My only writes are review records, sidecars and QA evidence/tests under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/qa/. I formed this verdict without reading any other round-4 review record. A domain-reviewer run was auto-committed during my run (8741de3); I read only its commit file list and its meta.json key names and counts, not its record or sidecar content.

summary: PASS on candidate sha256:0be571ea...a3b7 (commit 53f5d176). All seven required commands pass. My independent round-4 suite (41 cases on D-021-conformant disposable fixtures) passes 38/38 active cases, and every required A24/A25 rejection holds. Metadata-only changes leave the candidate unchanged. All ten earlier QA findings (F-DG0-201 to F-DG0-210) were reproduced on their original commits, or confirmed from the old text, and are verified fixed: CLOSED_VERIFIED in qa-verifier.verifications.json. Register, evidence content, agent-load, live-guard and feasibility checks: 0 errors. Three new Low, non-mandatory findings are raised and accepted by me as observations (pending release-auditor agreement): F-DG0-211, the gate record is not bound to the auditor run's outputs; F-DG0-212, a round can be backed by a fabricated, backdated new manifest (residual of F-DG0-208); F-DG0-213, a stale candidate.mjs comment. Orchestrator note: stages.json review_rounds[round 4].records lists only the three specialists. The release-auditor's round-4 record must be added there, otherwise its verifications sidecar (and any observation acceptance) is rejected as 'not listed in stages.json review_rounds'.
